description:
We are Bertrandt: an independent, international development service provider with long years of automotive expertise. We create technological solutions for our customers at any stage of the product development process with a focus on hot topics such as digitalization, e-mobility and autonomous systems, largely for the automotive, aerospace and mechanical engineering sectors.

Our goal: accelerating technological progress. We work on this every day – with aroundemployees at over 50 sites worldwide.


What to expect:

  • Location: business trips in Europe for 6 months (100% on-site work; remote work not possible; tasks performed in the customer area or in the garage)


Responsibilities:

• Test drive vehicles according to project routes and schedules

• Operate on-board logging devices and handle physical storage (SSDs)

• Strictly follow security and confidentiality protocols, including vehicle camouflaging when applicable

• Maintain the vehicles in good working order and ensure all maintenance is scheduled

• Write daily reports as well as documenting different information in JIRA

• Reporting defects with detailed error descriptions

• Debugging software errors

• Working with tools such as QFIL, TUT, WinSCP, JIRA, Linux, System Client, and DTS Monaco


What you bring along:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical domain

• Experience in vehicle UI/bench testing; prior knowledge of software updates is desirable

• Very good English skills

• Self-motivation, hands-on approach, motivation, interest in the product

• Driver’s license for more than 2 years


What we offer:

  • Flexible work environment
  • Private health insurance with optional medical packages for you and your family.
  • 24 vacation days, increasing to 25 days after 3+ years with us.
  • Meal tickets and Holiday vouchers.
  • Bookster and 7Card subscription.
  • Separate benefits related to the mission in Germany and Europe


*Our offices are located in Bucharest, Sibiu, and Cluj-Napoca
